pages.text: Ashen Wastes, Basalt Deltas and Molten Glass Lakes. A ring of broken basalt columns around an ancient forge: lava basin, Onyx anvil, blast furnaces and a smoking chimney. It is the lair of the $(l)Basalt Golem$(), which never leaves it. Its chest holds Molten Glass Shards, carapaces, onyx and sometimes netherite scrap or a Nether Lantern.
pages.title: Forge de basalte
